name: High-Protein Breakfast Basics
equipment: Eggs or Greek yogurt, and a piece of fruit or whole grain
instructions: Aim for at least 20-25g of protein at breakfast (eggs, Greek yogurt, cottage cheese, or a protein smoothie) -- it curbs mid-morning cravings far more than a carb-only breakfast.
Pair that protein with a fiber source (berries, whole-grain toast, oats) to slow digestion and keep energy steady.
Prep what you can the night before (overnight oats, hard-boiled eggs) so a rushed morning does not mean skipping breakfast.
Watch today's video for concrete high-protein breakfast ideas you can rotate through the week.
